_meta.note: KAS 0.66.43 reached through `kiro-cli acp --agent-engine v3 --auth-method cli` (kiro-cli 2.32.0), the production relay spawn, driven over stdio by a scratch client. Agent-to-client lines verbatim and in order, except: the session id is replaced with a fixed synthetic value, every engine-minted uuid with a numbered synthetic one, the scratch work dir reads as /work and the home directory as ~. Host inventory frames are omitted (_kiro/mcp/status, _kiro/tools/didChange, _kiro/powers/items_changed, _kiro/steering/documents_changed, _kiro/sessions/changed, _kiro/governance/state, _kiro/progressive_context/items_changed, _kiro/policy/changed, available_commands_update, config_option_update, and the steering_inclusion, display_error, context_usage and bookkeeping session_info_update kinds). KAS's initialize carries no agentInfo, so no agent name is recorded. The session/new response is kept TRIMMED to sessionId, modes.currentModeId and the probe's own availableModes entry; the rest lists the host's agents and entitlements. The saved spec at /work/.kiro/agents/probe.json was read with acp.kas_agents.load_agent_spec, projected with build_kas_custom_agents, sent as _meta.kiro.customAgents on session/new and activated with session/set_mode `probe` (its empty result is the third response). The probe spec names one stdio MCP server, `probe` (a scratch script whose one tool, probe_codeword, returns tangerine-42), in tools `@probe`, with `@probe/probe_codeword` in allowedTools. The mode is listed with origin client. Asked for the codeword, the model loaded and called @probe/probe_codeword with no permission request (serverName probe) and answered tangerine-42.
